(i) ART is highly cost-effective in resource-limited countries and that the benefits of treatment are greatest in the poorest settings, (ii) the benefits of treatment increase as more patients are started, (iii) the cost of treatment is lower than expected, and (iv) the benefits of ART are greatest for patients who start treatment early, before they become severely ill
the number of people starting ART increased substantially between 2005 and 2010 and that this increase is likely to continue in the near future.
the number of patients who are on ART in resource-poor settings has grown rapidly, but the unmet need for ART remains very high.
